blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — SM Supermalls is more than just a mall for retail and dining. As customers look for places to create new memories, SM Supermalls continues to transform into an all-day destination where they can do more—discover hobbies, catch the latest blockbusters, stay active, bond with their fur-babies, and forge new connections with a welcoming community. Today, SM Supermalls is evolving beyond the traditional mall experience, bringing together entertainment, leisure, wellness, and community in one vibrant and inclusive space.
